rows.label: tlk45400251_02_msg0001
rows.name:
I caught a glimpse of Special
Commissioner Meleph-sama recently!

rows.label: tlk45400251_02_msg0003
rows.name:
Toppling the villainous boy, then
launching him into the air...

rows.label: tlk45400251_02_msg0004
rows.name:
Then following up with attack after
attack for massive damage.

rows.label: tlk45400251_02_msg0005
rows.name:
Truly elegant... It was the ideal way
to fight.

rows.label: tlk45400251_02_msg0006
rows.name: Huh? That's not how you remember it?

rows.label: tlk45400251_02_msg0007
rows.name:
It's fine. That's how it looked to me
from far away.

rows.label: tlk45400251_02_msg0102
rows.name:
[ML:Feeling kind=Think ]What do I do? I'm lost for words...
The real Special Commissioner
Meleph-sama is right in front of me...
